scenarios.name: LV-1 Load probe: --plugin-dir overrides the installed craftflow
scenarios.given: an empty craftflow-managed scratch project (fresh git repo with .craftflow/state), CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID unset and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pointing at the scratch project
scenarios.when: claude -p --plugin-dir plugins/craftflow --model haiku --debug-file <file> runs a one-word prompt
scenarios.then: the debug log contains 'from --plugin-dir overrides installed version' at least once, proving the candidate plugin (not the installed one) is what the other scenarios exercise

scenarios.name: LV-2 Read-set parity: baseline 214,055 and candidate within the enforced BUILD cap
scenarios.given: the baseline commit pinned in router-baseline.lock.json read through --ref with the frozen router-readmap.baseline.json (A4), and the candidate working tree with its live read map
scenarios.then: the baseline start_total is exactly 214055 and the candidate start_total is <= enforced_caps.readset.BUILD from router-budget.json; the gap to the 60,000 goal is printed on stderr and stated in the impact report

scenarios.name: LV-3 EnterPlanMode denied live (or LIMITATION when the host does not offer the tool in -p mode)
scenarios.given: the candidate plugin loaded via --plugin-dir in a craftflow-managed scratch project
scenarios.when: a haiku session is told 'Call the EnterPlanMode tool now, nothing else' with stream-json output so the tool call is observable
scenarios.then: the hook log shows a native_plan_mode_denied row; if the tool was never called, LIMITATION:enterplanmode_not_offered (HV-4 must cover it); a call without a deny row is a FAIL

scenarios.name: LV-4 Plan commit denied live
scenarios.given: a craftflow-managed scratch repo with docs/plans/x.md present and gitignored
scenarios.when: a haiku session is told to run 'git add -f docs/plans/x.md' with Bash allowed
scenarios.then: git diff --cached --name-only is empty and the hook log shows a plan_commit_denied row

scenarios.name: LV-5 Ordinary commit allowed live (negative control)
scenarios.given: the same kind of scratch repo with an untracked src/a.txt
scenarios.when: a haiku session is told to run 'git add src/a.txt && git commit -m t' with Bash allowed
scenarios.then: HEAD is a commit 't' containing src/a.txt and the hook log has no plan_commit_denied row. This passes with no hook at all, so it is a negative control that means something only together with LV-4 and the load probe
scenarios.expected: exit 0; {"lv5":"PASS",...,"evidence_class":"B-SIMULATED"} (a per-step run has no load probe, so it is never Class A)

scenarios.name: Full lane: LV-1..LV-5 in one run (the Class A source for the impact report)
scenarios.given: the candidate plugin and a working claude CLI
scenarios.when: the driver runs every step with no --only; its summary line is passed to craftflow_router_context_impact.py --lv
scenarios.then: load_probe, lv2, lv4 and lv5 are PASS and lv3 is PASS or LIMITATION:enterplanmode_not_offered (only when claude exited 0 and its stream shows the session ran); evidence_class is A because the load probe passed in this same run
